asan_ubsan.allocation_result_provenance: Independent test agent tool result; CTest cost history retained privately.

negative_controls: Separate std node/vector allocation failures preserve FIFO, references, counts and reusable capacity.
Single-order flat replacement avoids transiently full probe table.
Stale pre-change replay binary was rejected for missing index/capacity metadata; rebuilt end-to-end smoke passed.
Runner rejects malformed/non-finite/oversized durations, diagnostics, variant/config mismatch, empty or differing checkpoints and changed artefacts.
observations: Standard-index replay median and range were higher than flat-index replay for each matched dataset/profile in this run.
Standard-index construction medians were lower in all four matched profiles.
Fitted flat-index capacity reduced streaming process peak RSS, but Nasdaq median replay rose from 29.4967858125 to 32.9497865205 seconds; ranges overlap.
BX fitted flat-index replay median fell from 0.990848146 to 0.7220029165 seconds.
Default standard-index RSS was lower; fitted Nasdaq standard-index RSS was slightly higher than flat. Memory is one streaming pass per configuration.
limitations: Two historical venue/day flows on one unpinned desktop Mac; not a universal ranking.
No hardware-counter or allocation-only attribution; concrete hash/bucket/allocator policies differ.
RSS includes the whole streaming process and allocator retention; not index-only bytes.
Sampled semantic state fingerprints are non-cryptographic; states between checkpoints remain unverified.
Six timing observations per configuration; no latency percentiles or inference of Linux performance.

retention.public_report: Per-run aggregate summaries, timing rows, execution order, identities and statistics; no per-event rows.

checks: All64 sequential launches, phase order, group rotation and balanced variant order verified.
All8 checkpoint configurations match actual private CSVs and retained prior-code checkpoints.
All128 process log identities, current binaries, caches, compiler records and source files match the report.
